*.headers: No extra request headers are needed to reach this deployment: the composed stack fronts the server directly, and every credential travels in the Authorization header the auth block mints. No case in the pinned catalogue requires a header declaration.

unauthenticated.administrative: This instance carries no credential at all; it exists to prove the 401 branch. An administrative posture is a property of a principal, and there is none, so the role-boundary cases addressing it are not applicable by construction.

smart_app.administrative: The SMART app principal is scoped by the SMART resource-scope grammar, not by the RBAC role set the role-boundary cases probe; its authorization is adjudicated by the SMART capability cases, so no administrative posture is claimed for it.

smart_platform.administrative: The SMART platform principal is scoped by the SMART resource-scope grammar, not by the RBAC role set the role-boundary cases probe; its authorization is adjudicated by the SMART capability cases, so no administrative posture is claimed for it.
